title: Amazon Digital Advertising Executive - Entry Level Graduate Role with
description:
MinsterFB are looking for a Digital Advertising Executive. To support their strong growth (3x increase in revenue and employees over the past 3 years) they are seeking a numerate, hard-working, online savvy individual to help drive growth for their clients on the Amazon platform. You will design and execute digital campaigns within a supportive learning environment. This role is a hands-on opportunity to develop digital marketing skills building, optimising and managing Amazon online advertising.

Amazon Advertising: is a sophisticated demand generation system within the world s largest online retailer.

Key Roles & Responsibilities:

You will be:
- Specifying and executing online advertising campaigns on behalf of their clients through the Amazon Advertising platform in the UK, Europe and the rest of the world
- Reporting on performance of search terms, ads and campaigns
- Optimising campaigns with the support of digital optimisation platforms
- Researching their client s products, competitors and markets

Key Skills:
- Strong numeracy
- Ability to work independently and to prioritise workload
- Confident use of PowerPoint, and Excel
- Good written and verbal communication skills

Desired Qualifications:
- Degree level qualification in a field that suggests an affinity with IT, Maths, Data Management or Digital Marketing
- If you are not a graduate you will be considered if you have a history of delivery in a similar environment
- Previous advertising experience is not required as full training is given

Key Personal Qualities:

MinsterFB are looking for somebody who is:
- Analytical - able to pick out and focus on the important measures
- Enthusiastic about all things marketing and digital
- Happy working carefully through complex and detailed tasks
- Willing to learn with a can do attitude
- Works well as part of a team
- Self-motivated
- Adaptable

Location:
- The Job is office based in our Southwell office a minimum of two days a week, when working from home you will be staying in regular contact through Zoom and MS Teams.
- We have a tight supportive culture that is strengthened through face to face interactions if you are unable to work two days a week from Southwell please don t apply
- For the first 4 weeks of your employment you will be required in the office everyday while you get to know the company and meet all of your colleagues.

Salary & Other Benefits:
- £26,227 p.a.
- Annual holiday entitlement is 33 days (inclusive of bank/public holidays) in the complete holiday year
- 3pm finish on a Friday

Job Details:
- Work hours are, Monday to Thursday 9am until 5.30pm, Friday 9am until 3pm
- This job unapologetically online / on screen. However with the flexibility that fantastic global internet coverage provides you will be able to work remotely anywhere in the world for up to 4 consecutive weeks a year
- In addition employees are entitled to a 3mth unpaid sabbatical after 4 years of continuous employment

About MinsterFB

MinsterFB works with some of the UK s favourite brands such as Grenade, Yorkshire Tea, McVitie s and Bisto to build their business on Amazon. They provide full account management, sales strategy, catalogue management, issue resolution and training. Key to their success is their deployment of all of the growth tools available to Amazon Sellers and Vendors.

MinsterFB is a Certified B Corporation. As such we re part of a global community of businesses that meet high standards of social and environmental impact

How to Apply

If this role is of interest please attach your CV to the link provided. We receive many CVs so to ensure yours is read please include the words I am able to work 2 days a week in Southwell in your application preferably in the subject line.

MinsterFB values a diverse workforce. Women, people of colour, people with disabilities, and members of the LGBTQ community are encouraged to apply. They believe an equitable and inclusive work environment and a diverse empowered team is key to achieving their mission. They re looking for candidates who can expand their business culture, are curious, plain-dealing, action orientated, bring their whole selves to work and meet the requirements of the role. All else is secondary. They strive to provide all candidates with an equitable and accessible recruitment process. If they can offer accommodations for you in the recruitment process or you have feedback on how to make their recruitment more accessible, please let them know.

title: Aston Martin Marketing Executive
description:
Aston Martin Nottingham have a fantastic opportunity available for a Marketing Executive to join our award winning team.

The successful candidate will become part of a driven and dynamic team, working with one of the most prestigious luxury brands in the world.

You will be involved in all key elements of the marketing functions, from planning events to managing daily social media posts. This is a fun, varied and fast paced role, and we are looking for a candidate who can add a creative flare to our marketing activities whilst ensuring all key KPI's are adhered to.

You will have excellent communication and inter-personal skills, be articulate and confident and have the necessary experience to carry out the required duties of this important and exciting role. You will have a strong work ethic and a passion to create innovative and creative marketing campaigns.

Key responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
- Ensuring all elements of margin related guidelines and KPI's are met every month/quarter
- Managing the integrity of both the manufacturers and dealerships databases
- Liaising with all manufacturers and its marketing agency to initiate, organise and deliver marketing activities and events
- Create customer specific campaigns
- Manage and edit pages Sytner and our manufacturer websites
- Use allowed Social Media platforms to create and grow awareness of the dealerships and product. You will have a natural flare for content creation and have the ability to bring new and exciting ideas to the various platforms.

You will need to be computer literate, have great attention to detail and be able to work under your own initiative adhering to strict deadlines when set.

title: CRM Manager
company: Harnham - Data & Analytics Recruitment - Agency - Permanent
description:
CRM Manager

Up to £50,000
Hybrid - Nottingham (1 day per week)

I'm hiring a Donor Engagement & Retention Manager for a well-established international humanitarian charity undergoing a major transformation in how fundraising is delivered globally.

This is a newly created role with a rare opportunity: build the donor retention function from the ground up and shape how the organisation engages, retains, and grows its supporter base.

The organisation

An international humanitarian charity working across more than 30 countries, delivering emergency relief alongside long-term programmes focused on education, healthcare, livelihoods, and clean water.

Following a wider organisational transformation, fundraising activity is becoming more centrally coordinated, creating an exciting opportunity to build a more strategic approach to supporter engagement and retention.

The role

Reporting into the Head of Fundraising Operations, you'll take ownership of retention strategy across the organisation's donor base.

This is not a campaign delivery role alone. They're looking for someone who can:
- Build a retention strategy from scratch
- Understand donor behaviour and audience segments
- Create meaningful supporter journeys
- Develop testing and optimisation frameworks
- Improve donor engagement and repeat giving
- Help shape the future retention function

The acquisition side is already established. The next phase is understanding how to retain supporters more effectively and maximise long-term donor value.

What you'll be doingDonor Retention & Engagement
- Develop and implement a donor retention strategy across:
- One-off donors
- Regular givers
- Major donors
- Lapsed supporters
- Build onboarding, nurture, feedback, and reactivation journeys.
- Create meaningful supporter experiences that improve engagement and retention.

CRM & Journey Development
- Use donor data and audience insights to develop segmented communication strategies.
- Build multi-channel journeys across:
- Email
- SMS
- WhatsApp
- Web
- Social media
- Telemarketing
- Develop testing plans to understand what drives repeat donations and supporter loyalty.

Analytics & Performance
- Monitor retention and engagement KPIs.
- Develop reporting and performance frameworks.
- Identify opportunities to improve campaign effectiveness and donor lifetime value.

Leadership & Team Development
- Initially work across existing teams and stakeholders.
- Help shape and build a future retention team (planned growth to approximately six people).
- Work closely with Donor Care, Marketing, Content, and Fundraising teams.

What they're looking for Essential
- CRM, retention, lifecycle, or supporter engagement experience.
- Experience building customer or donor journeys.
- Strong understanding of segmentation and campaign optimisation.
- Strong analytical mindset with the ability to use data to guide decisions.
- Experience measuring communication performance and retention outcomes.
- Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
- Comfortable operating autonomously and building new processes.

Highly desirable
- Fundraising or charity-sector experience.
- Donor retention experience.
- CRM and supporter engagement programmes.
- Experience building retention functions or strategies from scratch.

Tech

The charity is open on background and tools, but currently uses:
- Engage CRM
- SendGrid
- SMS platforms

Tool experience matters less than understanding retention, engagement, and customer journeys.

Why this role?
- Brand-new role with genuine ownership.
- Opportunity to build a retention function from scratch.
- Existing donor base and clean data foundations already in place.
- Significant freedom to shape strategy and ways of working.
- Meaningful mission with global impact.
- Strong support from leadership and fundraising teams.
- Opportunity to build and develop a future team.

Package
- Up to £50,000 salary
- Hybrid working (1 day per week in Nottingham)
- Potential occasional London travel
- 35-hour working week
- Strong opportunity for progression as the fundraising function expands

Interview process

Stage 1: 30-minute discussion with the Head of Fundraising

Stage 2: Task and presentation exercise

This role would suit someone currently working in:
- CRM & Retention
- Customer Lifecycle Marketing
- Supporter Engagement
- Donor Development
- Loyalty & Retention
- Fundraising Marketing

who wants the opportunity to build something from the ground up and have a visible impact on supporter engagement and long-term fundraising performance.

title: Digital Communications & Fundraising Officer
description:
Merrifield Consultants are delighted to partner with Framework Housing Association to recruit a Digital Communications & Fundraising Officer. Reporting to the Digital Team Manager, this role is an excellent opportunity to shape digital fundraising and communications that change lives for people facing homelessness in the East Midlands and Yorkshire.

Key details:

Salary: 29,909 - 32,838 per year

Contract: Full time, Permanent

Location: Nottingham, Hybrid, remote considered

Working pattern: 37 hours per week, with flexible working and hours worked between 8.30am and 5.30pm. Occasional evening and weekend work may be needed.

Closing date: Dynamic

Start Date: 1st February 2027

About the role:

This is a great opportunity to join the digital team of a well-established charity and make a real difference to people facing homelessness in Nottinghamshire, Lincolnshire, Derbyshire and Sheffield.

You will be responsible for the charity's email marketing, social media presence and digital fundraising campaigns, using data insight to increase income, grow supporter audiences and improve the donor experience. You will also work with people who have used the charity's services to tell their stories.

This role is ideal for a confident digital marketer who enjoys combining creative content with analysis and wants to build their experience in fundraising.

Key responsibilities
- Build, segment and deliver supporter email marketing.
- Develop multi-channel digital fundraising campaigns, including Engaging Networks pages.
- Grow digital networks and audiences to increase subscribers and donations.
- Manage social media and create content, including Canva assets and short and long-form video.
- Develop supporter journeys that turn new supporters into loyal donors.
- Tell service users' stories using a trauma-informed approach.
- Report on campaign results, budgets and cost effectiveness.
- Ensure compliance with the Code of Fundraising Practice and GDPR.

About You

You'll be a creative, compassionate self-starter who is confident working independently and enjoys turning data and storytelling into income for a cause you care about.

You will bring:
- Experience in digital marketing or communications, with a track record of growing social media audiences.
- Excellent writing skills, with persuasive, emotive copy and a keen eye for detail.
- Experience of building email campaigns in a platform such as Mailchimp.
- Experience of using supporter data and segmentation to target campaigns, analysing results and reporting back to stakeholders.
- Experience shooting and editing video, and creating designs in Canva or Adobe Creative Cloud.
- The ability to manage multiple projects on time and to budget.
- Degree level education or an equivalent qualification.
- A commitment to the charity's mission, empathy for the people who use its services and a good understanding of equality and diversity.

Experience of fundraising, Engaging Networks, Adobe Premiere Pro, data protection and fundraising regulation, or a general understanding of homelessness would be advantageous but is not essential. Training in Premiere Pro will be provided.

To apply

Please apply today with your CV for further information and a confidential conversation with Merrifield Consultants.

We practice a diverse and inclusive recruitment process that ensures equal opportunity for all we work with, irrespective of race, sexual orientation, mental or physical disability, age or gender. As an organisation, we encourage applications from all backgrounds and will ensure measures are met when required, to allow a fair process throughout.

title: Digital Content Editor
description:
Position title:

Digital Content Editor

Reports to:

Content and Copywriting Manager

Location:

Muslim Hands Head Office, 148 - 164 Gregory Boulevard, Nottingham, NG7 5 JE (Hybrid/Remote with occasional travel to Local Office and International Offices)

Hours of Work:

Full-time, 35 hours per week

Salary guideline:

(Up to) £35,000.00 per annum (commensurate with experience)

Terms of Employment:

Permanent (with a 6-Month Probationary Period)

Application Process & Closing Date:

Send an up to date CV and supporting Covering Letter by Email no later than 20th November 2026

Approx. Interview & Role Commencement Date(s):

Interviews: As Suitable Applications Received

Start: ASAP thereafter

Job overview:

Are you a digital content enthusiast who loves turning good content into great online experiences? We're looking for a creative, organised and digitally minded Digital Content Editor to bring our website, crowdfunding pages and app to life, keeping everything fresh, engaging and easy to navigate.

You'll be the go to person for publishing and maintaining digital content, from campaign pages and Islamic resources to photography, videos and stories straight from the field. You'll also help our digital platforms work smarter through SEO, high converting landing pages, conversion rate optimisation (CRO) and A/B testing. Working alongside our paid media campaigns, you'll use data, creativity and a keen eye for detail to improve the user journey and help turn clicks into meaningful action.

Responsibilities:
- Manage day to day content across our website and app using Umbraco (CMS).
- Publish and maintain engaging content, including appeals, campaigns, Islamic resources, events, crowdfunding pages, volunteering information, policies and governance.
- Ensure all content is accurate, engaging and consistent with the Muslim Hands tone of voice.
- Keep website navigation and content structure clear, intuitive and user friendly.
- Regularly review and refresh content to keep information relevant and up to date.
- Upload and format copy, photography, videos, downloadable resources and interactive content across our website and app.
- Apply on page SEO best practices and carry out keyword research to guide content planning.
- Monitor search performance and identify opportunities to improve visibility.
- Create and optimise high converting landing pages to support paid media campaigns.
- Identify ways to improve user journeys across our digital platforms.
- Plan and implement A/B tests across key landing pages and donation journeys.
- Track website performance using Google Analytics 4, Umbraco and other reporting tools, turning data into actionable improvements.

Person Specification:
- 2-4 years' experience managing website content.
- Experience using Umbraco or a similar content management system.
- Excellent copy editing and proofreading skills, with a sharp eye for detail.
- A strong understanding of SEO principles and how to improve search visibility.
- Knowledge of user experience (UX) and conversion rate optimisation (CRO).
- Strong organisational and project management skills, with the ability to juggle multiple projects and deadlines.
- Excellent attention to detail and a commitment to getting the little things right.
- Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities and meet deadlines.
- Strong communication skills and a collaborative approach.
- Experience working within a UK charity or NGO.
- Highly organised, proactive and comfortable managing several projects at once.

Requirements:

Candidates must have the right to work in the UK. The successful applicant will be required to undergo a DBS check, where applicable, in accordance with the requirements of the role. Candidates should have a relevant qualification or equivalent professional experience demonstrating the skills and expertise required for this position.

We reserve the right to cease advertising and close the Vacancy without notice should suitable candidates be identified ahead of the published 'Application Closing Date'.

title: Donor Engagement & Retention (CRM) Manager
company: Harnham - Data & Analytics Recruitment - Agency - Permanent
description:

Up to £50,000

Nottingham (1 day a week)

This is an exciting opportunity to build a donor engagement and retention function from the ground up. You will have the autonomy to shape strategy, influence supporter experiences, and drive long-term donor relationships across multiple channels while making a meaningful impact within a purpose-led organisation.

They are a well-established non-profit organisation committed to supporting communities facing poverty, crisis, and humanitarian challenges around the world. As a Donor Engagement & Retention (CRM) Manager, you will shape and lead a donor engagement strategy from the ground up, driving supporter retention and long-term fundraising growth.

- Design and optimise multi-channel supporter journeys, including onboarding, stewardship, feedback, and re-engagement programmes.
- Work closely with fundraising, marketing, and operational teams to deliver seamless donor experiences.

- Strong experience within fundraising, donor engagement, donor retention, or supporter development.
- Proven ability to create and implement retention strategies and supporter journeys.
- Experience using channels such as email, SMS, web, social media, telemarketing, messaging platforms, or donor apps.

title: Group Marketing Manager
description:
Group Marketing Manager
3 days based out of Hucknall, Nottingham - 2 days travelling Full-Time 40,000 - 48,000
We're recruiting on behalf of our client who are seeking a creative and commercially driven Group Marketing Manager to lead marketing activity across a diverse portfolio of attractions, events and customer experiences.
This is a hands-on leadership role for an experienced marketer who can combine strategy, creativity and commercial awareness to deliver campaigns that drive visitor numbers, customer engagement, revenue and brand growth.

You'll take ownership of the entire marketing process, from identifying audiences and commercial opportunities through to campaign development, delivery, optimisation and performance analysis.
Working closely with senior stakeholders, you'll develop innovative marketing campaigns that stand out in a competitive marketplace while delivering measurable business results.
Key Responsibilities
- Develop and deliver the annual marketing strategy and campaign calendar.
- Plan and execute integrated campaigns across digital, social media, content, PR, email and offline channels.
- Identify target audiences and use customer insight and market trends to shape campaigns.
- Drive website performance, SEO, paid advertising, social media and customer engagement activity.
- Lead content creation, campaign messaging and creative asset development.
- Manage the promotion of seasonal events, new attractions, launches and special initiatives.
- Monitor campaign performance, ROI and marketing KPIs, using data to optimise results.
- Manage marketing budgets, agencies and external suppliers.
- Build strong relationships across the business to ensure campaigns support wider commercial objectives.
- Identify new opportunities to grow audiences, increase repeat visits and enhance brand awareness.

You'll have:
- Proven experience in a Marketing Manager or Senior Marketing role.
- Strong management experience.
- Strong experience delivering integrated multi-channel marketing campaigns.
- Excellent digital marketing knowledge, including social media, content, email marketing and paid media.
- Experience using customer insight and data to drive marketing decisions.
- Strong commercial awareness and understanding of ROI and campaign performance.
- Excellent project management and organisational skills.

title: Marketing Manager
description:
Marketing Manager

Salary: £40,000-£45,000
Location:Sutton-in-Ashfield, Nottinghamshire
Hours:Full-time, 37.5 hours per week
Reports to:Sales & Marketing Director
Direct reports:None
Travel:Occasional UK travel to retailers, trade shows and brand partner meetings

The Opportunity

SF Partners are working exclusively with a leading specialist in branded furniture to recruit a commercially minded, hands-on Marketing Manager.

With a portfolio of recognised lifestyle and celebrity brands, and new partnerships planned for 2027, this is an opportunity to take ownership of marketing strategy and delivery across a growing collection.

Working closely with the Sales & Marketing Director, Creative Director and Product Director, you will bring each brand to life through product launches, retailer campaigns, digital content and trade activity. You will build relationships with retail and brand partners, helping drive sales while ensuring each brand's identity is represented consistently.

As part of a small, ambitious team, you will have the opportunity to make a significant impact across brand strategy, product storytelling and retail marketing.

Key Responsibilities

Brand Strategy and Planning
- Develop and deliver annual marketing strategies for each licensed furniture brand, supported by promotional and content calendars.
- Establish clear positioning, customer propositions and key messages for each collection.
- Maintain brand consistency across marketing activity and retail partner platforms, ensuring compliance with licensor guidelines and approval processes.

Retailer Marketing and Digital Content
- Create campaigns that help retail partners successfully launch and promote furniture collections.
- Develop and maintain retailer marketing toolkits, including point-of-sale materials, digital assets, social media content, store graphics and product launch packs.
- Work directly with retailers to tailor marketing support and improve online product presentation.
- Deliver email communications through HubSpot, keeping retailers informed about product updates, lead times, discontinued ranges and promotional activity.
- Maintain and develop consumer-facing websites, the company website and its retailer portal.
- Manage company social media channels and produce content that supports brand awareness and retailer sales.

Product Launches and Sales Support
- Develop compelling product stories and clear selling messages.
- Work with the Creative Director and Product Director to coordinate photography, video, CGI and launch materials.
- Organise and attend trade shows.
- Produce selling guides, product brochures and training presentations for retail partners and the internal sales team.

Brand Partner and Stakeholder Management
- Build strong relationships with licensed brand partners.
- Coordinate brand approvals and present marketing plans and campaign proposals.
- Identify opportunities for collaborative marketing activity.
- Manage external agencies, photographers, designers and printers.

Project, Budget and Campaign Management
- Manage multiple marketing projects, delivering activity on time and within budget.
- Plan and manage marketing budgets, monitor campaign performance and report on return on investment.
- Support the company's industry profile through award submissions, press releases and digital content.

Skills and Experience

Essential
- Previous experience in a Marketing Manager role.
- A track record of developing marketing strategies and delivering them through to execution.
- Strong project management skills, with the ability to work independently and manage competing priorities.
- Excellent copywriting, communication and presentation skills.
- Strong stakeholder management skills.
- Experience managing digital marketing channels and website content.
- Confidence using website administration systems and CRM platforms.
- Confidence using creative tools such as Adobe Creative Suite and Canva.
- Strong budget management, reporting and campaign analysis skills.
- High attention to detail and a commercially focused approach.

What Success Looks Like

Success will be measured through the delivery of annual marketing plans, timely product launches, retailer engagement and satisfaction, and the contribution of marketing activity to sales growth.

You will also be responsible for maintaining brand compliance, producing effective sales support materials, achieving strong campaign performance and delivering projects within budget.

You will influence everything from brand strategy and product launches to in-store experiences and digital campaigns, combining creative storytelling with practical marketing that supports commercial growth.

If this role sounds like something you would be interested in, please apply today.

Social Media Manager (Global)

Content and Copywriting Manager

Muslim Hands Head Office, 148 - 164 Gregory Boulevard, Nottingham, NG7 5 JE (Hybrid/Remote with occasional travel to Nottingham/London)

Hours of Work:

Full-time, 35 hours per week

(Up to) £33,000.00 per annum (commensurate with experience)

Permanent (with a 6-Month Probationary Period)

Send an up to date CV and supporting Covering Letter by Email no later than 20th November 2026

Approx. Interview & Role Commencement Date(s):

Interviews: As Suitable Applications Received

Start: ASAP thereafter

Job Overview

Are you a social media enthusiast who knows how to turn a scroll into a story, a follower into a community, and engagement into donations? As Social Media Manager at Muslim Hands, you'll take the lead in shaping our social media strategy across all our fundraising markets: UK, USA, Canada (CA), South Africa (SA) and France (FR).

From Instagram, Facebook and TikTok to YouTube, X, Reddit and whatever comes next, you'll know how to make every platform count. You'll bring our global strategy to life by working closely with country offices, sharing clear briefs, constructive feedback and performance insights to help teams create content that makes an impact. You'll also get out into the field regularly to capture authentic stories, gather content and connect with our fundraising teams. If you're just as comfortable analysing the numbers as you are spotting the next big trend, this role is for you.

- Develop and deliver our social media strategy across all existing and emerging platforms in the UK, USA, CA, SA and FR.
- Manage social content creators across fundraising offices, providing clear briefs, constructive feedback and regular reporting.
- Champion the Muslim Hands brand and tone of voice across all social media content.
- Conduct social media audits to identify opportunities and improve channel performance.
- Monitor online conversations, audience sentiment and emerging issues through social listening.
- Manage organisation wide requests and develop a clear social media briefing process.
- Engage with key followers and influencers across our social media accounts.
- Track and report on key metrics, including engagement, follower growth, impressions and reach.
- Travel to the field to capture compelling content and authentic stories.

- Experience in a fast paced fundraising environment where priorities can change quickly.
